test_title: PYST 22: SSC CGL 2025 Tier-I Similar Paper - English (Held On: 19th Sep 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question: What balance does the author recommend between law and morality?

options.text: Law should adapt to ethical concerns
Law and morality should be unrelated

solution: The correct answer is: **Option (3) i.e. Law should adapt to ethical concerns**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The passage suggests that modern democracies strive to **balance ethical concerns with legal neutrality**, meaning laws should be flexible enough to adapt to changing moral values and dilemmas. (कानून को नैतिक मुद्दों के अनुसार ढालना चाहिए) • **Example:** As new technologies create fresh ethical questions, legal systems must adjust to address those concerns. • **Law should adapt to ethical concerns** means that law and morality must interact, with laws evolving in response to society’s changing sense of right and wrong. (कानून को नैतिक चिंताओं के अनुसार ढलना चाहिए) • **Example:** Reforms like abolition of segregation happened when legal systems responded to moral movements. • This ensures that laws remain fair and relevant as society evolves. Therefore, the correct answer is- Law should adapt to ethical concerns [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Law must dominate morality** (कानून को नैतिकता पर हावी होना चाहिए): Means laws are always more important than moral principles. • **Example:** The passage suggests a balance, not dominance of law over morality. • **Morality should replace law** (नैतिकता को कानून का स्थान लेना चाहिए): Means only moral principles should guide society, with no legal systems. • **Example:** The author does not recommend that morality should entirely replace law. • **Law and morality should be unrelated** (कानून और नैतिकता असंबंधित होने चाहिए): Means there should be no connection between law and moral values. • **Example:** The author argues for an interactive balance, not separation. 43:Td4b, The correct answer is **Option 2**.
